cv:
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Software Engineer

Location: Lisbon, Portugal | Email: daniel.okafor-reyes@example.com | Phone: +351 555 010 202 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/daniel-okafor-reyes-example

Summary
Backend engineer with 7 years of experience designing and running Java/Spring Boot services for insurance and travel products. Comfortable with relational databases, event-driven integration with Kafka, and running services on Kubernetes. Looking for a team that cares about clean APIs and production quality.

Work Experience

Backend Engineer, Tejo Insurance Tech (Lisbon) - Jan 2022 to present
* Develop and maintain 7 Spring Boot microservices for policy quoting and claims intake (Java 17).
* Designed the REST API for the partner quoting integration used by 12 broker partners; versioned with OpenAPI.
* Consume and produce Kafka events for the claims workflow; introduced idempotent consumers and an outbox table, which removed duplicate claim records.
* Reduced p99 latency of the quote endpoint from 1.8 s to 450 ms by adding caching (Redis) and fixing N+1 queries in JPA.
* Deploy with Helm charts to Kubernetes (EKS) through Jenkins pipelines; on-call one week per month.

Software Developer, Viajar Online S.A. (Porto) - Sep 2019 to Dec 2021
* Built booking and payment features in a Java 11 / Spring MVC monolith backed by Oracle.
* Wrote integration tests with Testcontainers; raised test coverage of the payments module from 35% to 70%.
* Took part in splitting the monolith: extracted the notifications service (Spring Boot, RabbitMQ).

Junior Developer (internship then full-time), CodeFarol Lda (Porto) - Jul 2018 to Aug 2019
* PHP and later Java maintenance work for small business clients.

Education
BSc Informatics Engineering, Atlantic Polytechnic Institute, 2018

Technical Skills
Java (8-17), Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Kotlin (basic), REST/OpenAPI, Kafka, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Git, Linux

Languages
English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (conversational)
cover_letter:
Dear Tejo Insurance Tech recruitment team,

I would like to apply for the Backend Engineer (Java) position.

At Viajar Online I have spent over two years working on the booking and payments parts of a large Java application. I enjoy the moment when a slow, fragile part of a system becomes predictable, and I have done this several times, most visibly when I raised test coverage of the payments module from 35% to 70% using Testcontainers, which let us refactor it safely.

I was also part of the small group that started splitting our monolith. I extracted the notifications service into its own Spring Boot application, which taught me a lot about messaging, retries and the operational side of running separate services.

Insurance is new to me as a domain, but quoting and claims share many patterns with booking and payments: many partners, many rules, and a strong need for correctness. I am excited about the chance to work with Kafka and Kubernetes in production.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
